changes.motivation: The static config.json included the battery module for all machines, but only laptops have batteries. The config needed to be conditional on device type.
changes.summary: Deleted modules/common/sway/waybar/config.json and replaced it with a Nix-generated config in default.nix. Added isLaptop = config.deviceType == "laptop" and used lib.optionals/lib.optionalAttrs to conditionally include the battery module in modules-right and the battery config block only on laptop machines. The generated JSON is produced via builtins.toJSON and pkgs.writeText, replacing the static source = ./config.json reference.

problems: The EvalCheck revealed a pre-existing type error (float scale value passed to a sway option expecting a string) introduced by the feat(monitors) commit on main. This caused confusion — the agent had to stash changes and re-run the eval on main to confirm the error was not introduced by its own changes. The scale option introduced by that commit lacked type annotation or conversion, making it a silent latent breakage that only surfaces at eval time.
